items: 【EXTRAORDINARY COMFORT WITH 6.3"" CUSHIONS】Say goodbye to the ""bottoming out"" feeling common in standard 4-inch cushions. Our patio furniture set features 6.3-inch ultra-thick cushions filled with premium high-resilient polyfoam. Topped with soft polyester fiber and secured by built-in anti-slip straps, these cushions provide cloud-like support that maintains its shape even after long hours of relaxation

【100% RUST-PROOF ALUMINUM】While most competitors use heavy steel or mixed metals prone to rust, our set is crafted from 100% high-grade aluminum. It offers the timeless aesthetic of light brown wood grain with the lightweight, weather-resistant durability of metal. Perfect for humid poolside or coastal balcony environments without the worry of corrosion or fading.

【OEKO-TEX CERTIFIED SUSTAINABLE FABRIC】Experience the superior touch of 100% Olefin fabric, certified by OEKO-TEX Standard 100. This professional-grade outdoor material is water-resistant and exceptionally durable. The cream-colored covers are machine washable (cold, gentle cycle), ensuring your outdoor remains pristine and skin-friendly for your family and pets.

【VERSATILE MODERN CONVERSATION SETUP】Designed for the modern lifestyle, this 4-piece set includes 1 spacious three-seat sofa, 2 deep-seat armchairs, and 1 rectangular coffee table. The minimalist silhouette and neutral cream-on-wood palette seamlessly blend into various scenarios-from morning coffee on the deck to evening wine by the pool or cozy apartment balcony gatherings.

【EASY MAINTENANCE & AFTER-SALES SUPPORT】Spend more time enjoying and less time maintaining. The reversible back cushions and loose seat cushions allow for easy fluffing and cleaning. We provide clear assembly instructions and dedicated customer support to ensure a smooth setup. Transform your backyard into a luxury resort-style lounge today.
